_summary_en: Corner lot of about 489㎡ (surveyed) in Asakusa 6-chome, Tokyo, 6 minutes from Tsukuba Express Asakusa, zoned commercial (80% / 600%) with frontage on two roads. Currently a pay parking lot until March 2027, with vacant-land handover from April 2027. No total price is stated: the seller targets around ¥10M per tsubo. Check: the site was once a small printing-plate workshop, so a soil survey is recommended, and the buyer must obtain the hotel permit.
_findings: No total price is given, only 応相談 (negotiable) with a target of about ¥10M per tsubo. I left the price blank rather than multiply it out to roughly ¥1.48B.
The land has two areas: registered 486.21㎡ and surveyed 489.08㎡. I used the surveyed figure and noted the difference.
The land-history note says a small printing-plate workshop once stood here, which is a soil-contamination risk mentioned only in the letter's closing paragraph.
Part of the lot is still registered as 雑種地 (miscellaneous land) and needs a category change. That is easy to miss in a letter-format document.
